why:
I compared the builder brief with the verifier brief to see whether any check or probe appears in both. Step 4 of the builder brief contains a hand check: `printf 'name	age	city
ann	3	Oslo
bob	40	
' | node bin/csv2json.js --tsv` "should print exactly what" `printf 'name,age,city
ann,3,Oslo
bob,40,
' | node bin/csv2json.js` prints. That is the same input set and the same equality condition as the verifier's Check 1 probe and its SAME PASS condition. This is not just a command the expect line names. The expect line names `node bin/csv2json.js --tsv`, not these inputs and their comparison. So the builder brief gives away the checker's own probe. The other builder steps are allowed: running `npm test`, writing its own CLI test, and the README instruction, which doesn't mention the verifier's grep. Step 4 alone breaks the criterion.
